name: private_frame_checkpoint

test_list.description: Recover a sealed map using the exact session, frame, step and transcript.
Reject altered ciphertext, ownership or transcript bindings.
Do not publish the journal event when required checkpoint persistence fails.
Keep private recovery files outside model-readable workspace paths.

inputs.name: checkpoint
inputs.description: Actual journal and vault state with an explicit host key owner.

output_type: Result<private checkpoint or restored PiiVault, PrivateCheckpointError>
output_description: Authenticated recovery state, or a sanitized failure. Implementation and integration verification deferred by user instruction.
